up-picocom: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
picocom (bin/picocom, share/man/man1/picocom.1, licenses/picocom) GPL v2 or later upterm-ports (pkgs/picocom)

Notes
- These files were part of up-term.lha until the slim base (P9); the package installs them at the
  same paths in UP-Term:. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/picocom/SOURCES.txt.
- The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is up-term-src.lha, published next to
  up-term.lha.
